entity: Share of ICE detainers on people with a criminal conviction, national, FY23 to FY26
what_we_add: The 43% to 16% same-months comparison, FY23 vs FY26, with FY25 at 33%
why: Deportation Data Project (2026-09-08) states the finding in words: detainers rose by increasingly targeting people without convictions. TRAC's 28% for early 2025 sits between our endpoints. Nobody has the FY23-FY26 matched-months numbers.
